key_evidence_spans: A 40-year-old woman from southern Nepal presented with a 5-year history of progressive, painless enlargement of her left breast
well-defined, soft mass measuring 34×26×6 cm with dilated surface veins
Ultrasonography showed a homogeneously hyperechoic mass deep to the breast and pectoralis major muscle
Mammography revealed a heterogeneous lucent mass in the left retromammary region involving the pectoralis muscle
Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a well-defined, homogeneous T1- and T2-hyperintense mass
The clinical and imaging findings were consistent with a benign lesion
A core biopsy was not performed because the clinical and imaging findings were consistent with a benign lesion
